requirements.title: British female Nexus voice
requirements.acceptance: A user-selected warm British female Nexus voice preserves consistent pace, pronunciation, and volume; a fallback voice may not silently replace her identity.

requirements.title: Personalized greeting
requirements.acceptance: The signed-in Ron experience says exactly “Hello Ron, how can I help?” without exposing Nexus before authentication.

requirements.title: Wake phrase recognition
requirements.acceptance: Nexus recognizes “Nexus,” “Hello Nexus,” and “Hey Nexus” through spoken audio.

requirements.title: Listening, thinking, speaking cycle
requirements.acceptance: Every successful turn visibly and truthfully follows Listening → Thinking → Speaking → Listening.

requirements.title: Continuous conversation
requirements.acceptance: After the initial user gesture, Nexus completes multiple turns and resumes listening without another microphone tap.

requirements.title: Natural interruption
requirements.acceptance: User speech interrupts Nexus output and the same session continues without duplicate turns.

requirements.title: Single audio owner
requirements.acceptance: Exactly one Nexus voice is audible with no echo, overlapping playback path, or duplicate response.

requirements.title: Conversation memory
requirements.acceptance: Names, goals, location, language, and active tasks remain available across turns under the approved privacy and forgetting policy.

requirements.title: Automatic multilingual switching
requirements.acceptance: Nexus detects and switches among English, Spanish, French, Swahili, Arabic, and Portuguese without losing the active task.

requirements.title: Spoken completion confirmation
requirements.acceptance: Nexus speaks a truthful confirmation only after a workspace is visible or an action has a verified completion receipt.

requirements.title: Visible populated workspaces
requirements.acceptance: Each of the 13 routes opens the correct visible workspace with command-specific content and a visible acknowledgement.

requirements.title: Correction and navigation commands
requirements.acceptance: Commands including “No, open Maps” and “Go back” correct the active route without restarting voice.

requirements.title: Honest provider status
requirements.acceptance: Nexus distinguishes available, unavailable, queued, prepared, and completed provider states and never fabricates execution.

requirements.title: Consent for consequential actions
requirements.acceptance: Calls, messages, healthcare sharing, purchases, and provider requests require clear user consent before execution.

requirements.title: Accessible voice controls
requirements.acceptance: The experience provides a visible microphone, readable text, captions, replay, volume, and slower-speech controls with keyboard and screen-reader support.

requirements.title: Low-bandwidth and Offline Queue recovery
requirements.acceptance: Interrupted or low-bandwidth work is recoverable, queueable when safe, and clearly represented in Offline Queue.

requirements.title: Responsive and recoverable runtime
requirements.acceptance: Response latency stays within the certified budget, network interruptions reconnect, and errors recover gracefully without losing microphone ownership.

requirements.title: User-selectable preferences
requirements.acceptance: Voice, pace, volume, captions, language, and accessibility preferences are user-selectable without modifying the certified runtime foundation.

requirements.title: Production execution receipts
requirements.acceptance: Calls, reminders, searches, routes, provider requests, and every executed action produce provider-backed, inspectable receipts.

requirements.title: Certified runtime and all 13 workspaces
requirements.acceptance: The protected foundation, voice transport, microphone behavior, intelligence, six languages, safety routing, and the exact 13-workspace matrix remain intact.
